subject: Request for exceptional Hosted API rate relief for Nexera (>20%)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.k@nexerahealth.com>, procurement@nexerahealth.com
Date: 2027-05-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Nexera Hosted API rate relief (25% ask) — DEAL-48321

Mina / Marissa,

Quick context: Nexera (enterprise health analytics) is asking for an exceptional hosted-API price concession ahead of signing a 3-year, multi-region contract. The ask is a 25% across-the-board reduction to our standard hosted-api usage rate for the first 18 months, tied to a committed ramp (forecast attached). Key commercial points:

- Expected tokens/month: ramp to ~8–10B tokens/mo by month 12 (see forecast).
- Contract term: 36 months, with a meaningful multi-year commitment and marketing co-sell add-on.
- Why they need hosted: regulatory constraint in one region prevents Dedicated deployment in Q1; they need the hosted endpoint in other regions while we enable private on-prem later.
- Upside: large sustained volume, potential marketplace listing and case study, reference account for healthcare vertical.

Attachments: Nexera_usage_forecast_2027.xlsx, SOW_Nexera_v2.pdf.

Why I'm escalating: our standard approval threshold for discounts >20% needs senior authorization. My ask: approval to offer up to a 25% reduction for months 0–18 with the following controls:

- Step-up clause: rate increases to no more than 12% off standard from month 19 onward unless committed volume is met.
- Minimum committed spend: $1.5M ARR guaranteed year 1 (contractual).
- Quarterly usage review and automatic reprice if actuals are below 70% of forecast.

Request: Can we get senior sign-off (Mina) on this concession and permission to draft a concession memo for legal? I’ve looped Samira and procurement on visibility.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call.

—
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.k@nexerahealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-07T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Nexera Hosted API rate relief (25% ask) — DEAL-48321

Mina / Ben — thanks for the context. I reviewed the forecast and the downstream economics. Short answer: I support an elevated concession here but recommend we land at 22% rather than 25% as the public-facing cap for months 0–18. Rationale:

- Protects margin while still materially improving customer economics.
- Gives us room to offer one-time engineering migration credits to offset the Dedicated transition later (rather than deeper recurring discounts).

Suggested commercial guardrails for approval memo (I attached a short concession_memo_Nexera.pdf):
- 22% maximum recurring discount on hosted usage for months 0–18.
- One-time migration credit (up to $150k) applied to professional services/SOW.
- Mandatory usage-forecast milestones at months 3, 6, 12 with auto-review.
- Legal to add a reprice clause if usage falls below 60% of forecast for two consecutive quarters.

If Mina is comfortable with 22% + migration credit + SOW protections, I can draft the concession memo and loop Legal for a fast-track review. Ben — please confirm the exact guaranteed ARR and whether marketing commitments (case study / logo) are acceptable to the customer.

—
Marissa Cole
Director, Deal Desk, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.k@nexerahealth.com>, procurement@nexerahealth.com
Date: 2027-05-07T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Nexera Hosted API rate relief (25% ask) — DEAL-48321

Thanks Marissa — that sounds reasonable. Quick clarifications as you requested:

- Guaranteed ARR: Nexera has agreed to a minimum committed spend of $1.6M ARR in year 1 (they confirmed in procurement email). I’ve reflected that in the attached updated forecast.
- Marketing / reference: they will agree to a joint case study after production launch and a short video quote (public ok).
- Migration credit: acceptable; they prefer that as a PS credit.

I’ve updated the ask to 22% off standard hosted usage for months 0–18, migration credit up to $150k, and the step-up/reprice guardrails Marissa suggested. Attachments: updated Nexera_usage_forecast_2027.xlsx (v2).

Ben — please advise if you want me to proceed with a formal concession memo for Legal/Litigation review or if we can treat this as approved pending signature.

Best,
Ben

Thanks team — appreciate the speed here. After reviewing the concession memo and the updated forecast, I authorize a 22% hosted usage discount for months 0–18 under the following binding conditions:

1) Contract must include the committed spend clause: minimum $1.6M ARR in year 1; failure to meet this will trigger automatic reprice to no more than 12% discount going forward.
2) Migration credit capped at $150k and applied only once to the SOW.
3) Legal to include a two-quarter consecutive under-delivery clause (below 60% of forecast) that allows us to reprice retroactively.
4) Marketing/reference commitment must be contractual (case study and short testimonial within 9 months).

Marissa: please draft the concession memo and route to Legal (legal-team@redwood.com) and Revenue Ops for signature. Ben: proceed to update the commercial SOW and send the DocuSign link to procurement with the negotiated terms. Copy me on the final.

Mina
VP, Sales — Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
